scope: Actual UI/service/native IndexedDB, SDK failure injection; no live project or physical device

results.name: Name click opens Coach history once and never queues a mark
Permission failure in a history request is reported without a mark
Denied version read preserves native Journal intent and shows a permission label
Repeated sync cannot silently replay a permission-blocked intent
Admin exact-ID audit uses one inspector read and no month scan or write
After Admin verification explicit user review can safely rebase and ACK
